messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Oblique bifactor model
parts:
Hi Danilo,

What is an oblique bifactor model? By definition, bifactor models are orthogonal in their latent traits. Otherwise, the model may not be properly identified. It is however possible to obtain exploratory bifactor models post-rotation by a) fitting an exploratory model with K factors extracted and b) using summary(mod, rotate = 'bifactorT')  (or 'bifactorQ'). 

Phil
